Title: Building
Description: A structure with a roof and walls, such as an office building or factory.

Title: Cabinet
Description: A distribution cabinet to which end users are connected by a standard phone line.

Title: Cable well
Description: An underground structure less than 10 m long for cable and enclosure installation and maintenance that consists of a cover and a main frame. Also known as a chamber or manhole.

Title: Data centre
Description: A structure, or group of structures, dedicated to the centralized accommodation, interconnection and operation of information technology and network telecommunications equipment.

Title: Pole
Description: A support commonly used to carry aerial fibre optic cables or for joint use with electrical power cables in distribution/middle-mile networks.

Title: Pylon
Description: A tall tower-like structure used for carrying electricity cables high above the ground in transmission/backbone networks. Also known as a transmission tower.

Title: Tower
Description: A ground-based or rooftop structure that supports antennas for sending or receiving radio waves.
